loc_lasersplus_menu_user_desc: Change your own lasers and flashlights
loc_lasersplus_menu_team_desc: Change your teammates' lasers and flashlights
loc_lasersplus_menu_enemy_desc: Change sniper and other NPC lasers and flashlights
loc_lasersplus_menu_turret_subheader_att: These options affect SWAT Turrets that are attacking
loc_lasersplus_menu_turret_subheader_rld: These options affect SWAT Turrets that are reloading
loc_lasersplus_menu_turret_subheader_mad: These options affect SWAT Turrets hacked by ECMs
loc_lasersplus_gadget_network_sync_desc: Send your gadget colors to other players
loc_lasersplus_laser_redfilter_desc: Teammates' Lasers with too much red will be changed to your Teammate Laser Color.
loc_lasersplus_qol_defaultgadget_desc: Changes newly-purchased lasers or flashlights to your LasersPlus laser or flashlight color.
loc_lasersplus_gadget_multigadget_desc: Allows toggling multiple gadgets, and adds a separate keybind for sight gadgets such as the 45 Degree Sights or Sight Magnifiers.
loc_lasersplus_gadget_overload_desc: If true, turns on all laser/flashlight gadgets at once on keypress.
loc_lasersplus_menu_user_header_desc: Change the appearance of your lasers and flashlights below
loc_lasersplus_menu_team_header_desc: Change the appearance of other heisters' lasers and flashlights below
loc_lasersplus_menu_enemy_header_desc: Change the appearance of NPC lasers and flashlights below
loc_lasersplus_menu_world_header_desc: Change the appearance of vault lasers below
loc_lasersplus_menu_turret_header_desc: Change the appearance of SWAT Turret lasers below
